mechanisms.entryAndFailure: F wow_user_cleanup_bound constructs temporary tree links from existing enrolled table and restores root/clears links in finally. It folds object_release_failed into return. Lifecycle entry holds existing USER serialization and prepares exiting task windows outside that lock; thread retirement only withdraws after cleanup succeeds. Module unload is not thread destruction. S13 must preserve these relationships; no runtime proof of all failure/reentrancy cases claimed.
mechanisms.event: Original exitwin registration allocates/zeros record, references event with EVENT_ALL_ACCESS, then stores callback/client handle and links record; failure frees allocation. Current native event reference only duplicates, queries granted access and object type, and releases failed duplicate. It has no task, window, guest or product state. Function body and signature unchanged when moved B.
mechanisms.eventLifetime: F wow_user_task_lifecycle_register holds existing runtime serialization around original registration. Original taskman consumes retained event; F process disposal closes it after threads/classes/objects retire. Event primitive ownership B does not transfer lifecycle ownership or introduce a second event. C0117 mixed task-order header remains open.
